options.content:
## Observed parked energy-estimate changes
Net signed BMS EnergyRemaining change divided by actual observed duration, not max-minus-min over an assumed hour. Only intervals up to 120 seconds with Gear=P and explicit Disconnected charge state qualify; state changes or observed motion reject an interval. Partial coverage is not total parked time. EnergyRemaining is a BMS estimate, not a calibrated drain meter; negative values mean an estimated energy increase. Sentry association is not causation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH energy AS (
  SELECT ts, float_value AS wh, LEAD(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts,
    LEAD(float_value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_wh
  FROM signal_log WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND field = 'EnergyRemaining' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
), parked AS (
  SELECT ts, wh-next_wh AS loss_wh, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_ts-ts)) AS seconds,
    (SELECT se.str_value FROM signal_log se WHERE se.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND se.field = 'SentryMode' AND se.ts <= energy.ts ORDER BY se.ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS sentry
  FROM energy
  WHERE next_ts > ts AND next_ts-ts <= INTERVAL '120 seconds'
    AND (SELECT g.str_value FROM signal_log g WHERE g.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND g.field = 'Gear' AND g.ts <= energy.ts ORDER BY g.ts DESC LIMIT 1) = 'P'
    AND (SELECT c.str_value FROM signal_log c WHERE c.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND c.field = 'DetailedChargeState' AND c.ts <= energy.ts ORDER BY c.ts DESC LIMIT 1) = 'Disconnected'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM signal_log x WHERE x.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
      AND x.ts > energy.ts AND x.ts <= energy.next_ts
      AND ((x.field = 'Gear' AND x.str_value IS DISTINCT FROM 'P')
        OR (x.field = 'DetailedChargeState' AND x.str_value IS DISTINCT FROM 'Disconnected')
        OR (x.field = 'VehicleSpeed' AND ABS(x.float_value) > 1)))
) SELECT SUM(loss_wh)*3600/NULLIF(SUM(seconds),0) AS "Estimated W" FROM parked
